seoTitle: Tip Calculator - Split the Bill & Calculate Gratuity
metaDescription: Free tip calculator. Easily calculate restaurant gratuity based on a percentage and quickly split the total bill among friends.
intro: Dining out with friends and need to figure out the tip? Our Tip Calculator makes it easy to calculate gratuity and split the final bill evenly among your group. Calculating the right tip ensures that service workers are fairly compensated while keeping you within your personal budget. Stop feeling anxious when the bill arrives and start using our tool to manage your expenses with confidence. Make every dining experience more enjoyable by eliminating the stress of mental math and awkward calculations at the table. Avoid leaving too little and appearing rude, or leaving too much and overspending. Whether you are at a cafe or a fine dining restaurant, this tool adapts to your needs. It can even handle complex situations with ease. Enjoy your dining experience and leave the math to us. Calculate your tips accurately every single time.
whatIs: This tool calculates a percentage-based tip from a total bill amount and optionally divides both the tip and the total cost by the number of people paying.
howToUse: Enter the total Bill Amount before tip.
Select or type the Tip Percentage you wish to leave.
Enter the Number of People splitting the bill.
The tool will instantly show the tip amount and total cost per person.
howItWorks: The tool multiplies the bill amount by the tip percentage to find the total tip. It adds this to the original bill to get the total amount. If there are multiple people, it divides these totals by the number of people.
workedExample: If your bill is $50, you leave a 20% tip, and there are 2 people: The total tip is $10. The total bill becomes $60. Split 2 ways, each person pays $5 in tip and $30 in total.
resultInterpretation: The tool shows you the 'Total Amount' which is your bill plus tip. If splitting, 'Per Person' tells you exactly how much each individual needs to contribute.
useCases: Restaurants: Calculating the customary 15-20% tip on a meal.
Group Dinners: Splitting a large check evenly without doing mental math.
Services: Figuring out tips for haircuts, taxi rides, or food delivery.
tipsAndLimitations: Customary tip percentages vary by country. In the US, 15-20% is standard for restaurants.
This tool splits the bill completely evenly. It does not itemize based on who ordered what.

faq.question: Should I calculate the tip before or after tax?
faq.answer: Traditionally, gratuity is calculated on the pre-tax amount. However, many people simply calculate it on the total post-tax bill for convenience.

faq.question: What is a standard tip amount?
faq.answer: In North America, 15% is standard for average service, 18% for good service, and 20% or more for excellent service.

cta: Calculate your tip and split your bill now!
disclaimer: This tool is for quick estimation and convenience purposes only.
